List available DYRESM-CAEDYM versions

Source: R/install_dy_cd.R
list_dy_cd_versions.Rd

Scans all releases of repo and returns every DYRESM-CAEDYM version that has a binary attached, along with which AEME release (package version) and platform each one belongs to. Mirrors list_glm_versions().

Usage

list_dy_cd_versions(repo = "limnotrack/AEME", os = NULL)

Arguments

repo

Character. The "owner/repo" GitHub repository to search. Defaults to "limnotrack/AEME".

os

Character or NULL. If supplied, one of "windows", "macos", or "linux", restricting results to that platform. If NULL (the default), all platforms are included.

Value

A data frame with one row per available (release, platform, version) combination, with columns package_release, os, and dy_cd_version. Returns a zero-row data frame (with a message) if nothing is found.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
list_dy_cd_versions()
list_dy_cd_versions(os = "windows")
} # }
